name: Historical Earthquake Data Load

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  historical-load:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run historical load
        run: |
          python src/historical_load.py

      - name: Verify database creation
        run: |
          ls -la database

      - name: Upload SQLite database
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: earthquake-sqlite-database
          path: database/earthquake.db
